Name: Platonic's Pumpkin Days Hybrid Plants
Author: Macskasajt
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Requires SMAPI and Json Assets[/b]!

For those who played "Pumpkin Days" before the hybrid plants may be familiar, so if you are a fan of "Pumpkin Days", you should check this mod out!

The mod will contain most if not every hybrid plants found in the mentioned game, but it will take me some time to do all of them. So feel free to use the "Posts" section to share your thoughts with me. :)

[center][size=5]
List of plants in the current version (1.9)[/size][/center]
- Banapple
- Bellchee
- Crattuce
- Ginger Dragon
- Jalaplant
- Pealum
- Potarrot
- Raspkins
- Spinip
- Tomatelon



[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Please note that all the seeds are available from the 3rd year![/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Download Instructions (If you already have SMAPI)[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] mod[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Extract it to your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch the game with SMAPI5.[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Have Fun! :)[/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
